contexts.text: It was in the mouth of his wallet () = that they were... stored up in the threshold of the exterior Natural. AC 5657.
A wallet = the exterior Natural. AC 5661. AC 5733. AC 5767.
When we opened our wallets () = introspection into the exterior Natural.
Fill the wallets of the men with food () = (influx) into the Natural with the good of truth.
And put the silver of each one in the mouth of his wallet () = over and above with truth anew in the exterior Natural.
They took down every man his wallet to the earth () = that they brought the things which were in the Natural down to sensuous things.
